name: CRM-X

hero.title: AI CRM That Helps You Manage Every Opportunity on One Screen.
hero.lead: CRM-X is AI CRM and sales automation software that brings customer information, sales opportunities and team activities together on one platform. AI flags the opportunities waiting for follow-up and takes over repetitive work, so your team can focus on closing deals.

sections.heading: Eliminate the Blind Spots That Slow Down Sales.
sections.sub: When customer information is scattered, sales runs on memory and guesswork. If any of the situations below sounds familiar, this is exactly where CRM-X comes in.

items.title: Customer Lists Stuck in Spreadsheets
items.body: Every rep has their own file, and every file has a different version. CRM-X collects all customer and contact records in a single, up-to-date source.

items.title: Forgotten Follow-Ups
items.body: The proposal was sent, nobody followed up, and the opportunity quietly went cold. CRM-X reminds you of every pending follow-up, with its owner and date.

items.title: Customer Memory Tied to Individuals
items.body: When a team member leaves, the conversation history leaves with them. CRM-X turns every interaction into an accessible customer history that belongs to the organization.

items.title: A Sales Funnel Built on Guesswork
items.body: Which opportunities are really moving forward gets asked out loud in meetings. CRM-X shows the stage and latest activity of every opportunity on a single board.

items.title: Endless Manual Data Entry
items.body: Instead of talking to customers, the sales team is busy updating records. CRM-X hands repetitive entry and update work over to automation.

items.title: Relationships That Break After the Sale
items.body: The moment a deal closes, the customer becomes invisible and the chance of a repeat purchase slips away. CRM-X keeps following the journey after the sale and makes loyalty opportunities visible.

sections.heading: One Cycle. From First Contact to Loyalty.
sections.sub: CRM-X treats the customer relationship not as disconnected records, but as a self-reinforcing six-stage cycle. Each stage leaves data for the next.

items.title: Contact
items.body: A prospect (lead) becomes visible for the first time; where they came from and what they showed interest in are recorded.

items.title: Qualification
items.body: Need, budget and timing become clear; the team sets priorities based on data, not gut feeling.

items.title: Opportunity
items.body: Interest turns into a concrete sales opportunity with an owner, an estimated value and a stage.

items.title: Proposal
items.body: Meetings, revisions and follow-up dates all move forward under a single opportunity record.

items.title: Win
items.body: The deal closes; the reason it was won or lost is kept for future decisions.

items.title: Loyalty
items.body: Post-sale interactions are tracked; repeat purchase and cross-sell opportunities start the cycle again.

sections.heading: Four Capabilities. One Customer View.
sections.sub: Customer records, automation, reporting and journey analysis don't live in separate tools; they all work around the same record.

items.title: Manage Customers and Opportunities Together
items.body: The company card, contacts, meeting notes and open opportunities sit on the same screen. See at a glance which stage each opportunity is at and when the last contact happened.

items.title: Leave Repetitive Work to Automation
items.body: Open a task when the stage changes, alert the owner when a follow-up date arrives. Define the rule once, and the system applies it with the same discipline to every record.

items.title: Read Performance from Live Data
items.body: Track the sales funnel and opportunity progress by team and by rep on ready-made dashboards. Spot the stage where deals get stuck before the meeting, and plan priorities accordingly.

items.title: Follow the Customer Journey End to End
items.body: Bring every touchpoint, from first interaction to after-sales, together on a single timeline. Find where the journey breaks and make the experience consistent from that point on.

sections.heading: It Doesn't Just Store Data. It Suggests the Next Step.
sections.sub: The AI layer in CRM-X works on top of your records: it tells your team in plain language what's waiting, what's going cold and what's a priority. The decision always stays with the team.

items.title: See the Next Best Action
items.body: Last contact date, time spent in the stage and open tasks are evaluated together. CRM-X suggests who to call today and which proposal to follow up on, with the reasoning behind it.

items.title: Turn Meeting Notes into Structured Records
items.body: Decisions, objections and the next date are extracted from the free-text notes you write after a meeting. Record fields are filled in with your approval; no more copy and paste.

items.title: Spot Cooling Opportunities Early
items.body: Opportunities with no recent activity or overdue follow-ups are flagged on the board. The owner is alerted before they're lost, and the manager sees the same picture at the same time.

items.title: Get Reports by Asking
items.body: Type 'Which opportunities have been waiting in the proposal stage for two weeks?' instead of building filters. CRM-X returns the answer as a table, with links to the related records.

items.title: Stay in Control with Permissions and Activity Logs
items.body: Define by role which team can see and edit which customer data (RBAC). Every approved suggestion and change is recorded with a timestamp.

sections.heading: Every Team Sees the Same Customer. Through Its Own Eyes.
sections.sub: From sales reps to managers, from support to marketing, CRM-X turns the same customer record into a separate workspace for every role.

items.title: Sales Teams
items.body: Start the day with a prioritized call and follow-up list. Update opportunity stages by dragging them, and run the proposal process from a single record.

items.title: Sales Managers
items.body: Monitor funnel health and stuck stages by team. Run forecast meetings from a live dashboard instead of verbal updates.

items.title: Customer Relations and Support
items.body: When a customer calls, have their purchase history, open requests and latest conversation in front of you. Manage the after-sales experience from the same information as the sales team.

items.title: Marketing
items.body: See which lead sources turn into opportunities. Steer your campaign budget by funnel data, not by gut feeling.

items.title: Fast-Growing Companies
items.body: As the team grows, tie the process to the system, not to individuals. A new rep can take over the customer history from day one.

items.title: New Product Launches
items.body: Gather prospects interested in a launch under a separate funnel. Share early feedback and conversion stages with the product team on the same board.

sections.heading: One Source Instead of Scattered Tools.
sections.sub: We didn't compare CRM-X to a brand, but to the setup most teams work with today: spreadsheets, inboxes and follow-ups that depend on memory.

items.title: Customer Information
items.body: In the usual setup, it's scattered across personal files and inboxes. In CRM-X, it's a single, up-to-date record that belongs to the organization.

items.title: Follow-Up Discipline
items.body: In the usual setup, it depends on memory and personal calendars. In CRM-X, it runs on automatic tasks and reminders tied to the stage.

items.title: Sales Forecast
items.body: In the usual setup, it's reported verbally in meetings. In CRM-X, it's a live dashboard fed by stage and latest-activity data.

items.title: AI Support
items.body: In the usual setup, it either doesn't exist or lives in a separate tool. In CRM-X, it works on top of your records and shows the reasoning behind every suggestion.

items.title: After-Sales Relationship
items.body: In the usual setup, it disappears once the deal closes. In CRM-X, the journey keeps being tracked and repeat purchase opportunities come to the fore.

items.title: Data Access and Records
items.body: In the usual setup, whoever gets the file sees everything. CRM-X has role-based access (RBAC) and a timestamped change history.

sections.heading: Questions Asked Before Deciding.
sections.sub: The questions we hear most often during the buying process, with clear answers.

items.title: What is CRM-X, and how is it different from a classic CRM?
items.body: CRM-X is an AI-powered customer relationship management (CRM) platform that brings customer records, sales opportunities and team activities together on one platform. It goes beyond record-keeping: it flags opportunities waiting for follow-up and suggests the next step with its reasoning.

items.title: Can we migrate our existing Excel lists and customer records?
items.body: Yes. Your customer, contact and opportunity data are transferred into the CRM-X structure during migration. Field mapping and duplicate cleanup are planned together with your team during setup.

items.title: Does the AI make decisions on its own?
items.body: No. The AI produces suggestions, offers to fill in record fields and flags risky opportunities; changes only become permanent with user approval. The data behind every suggestion is visible on screen.

items.title: Is our customer data secure, and how is KVKK handled?
items.body: You decide by role who can see and edit which customer data, and changes are recorded with a timestamp. Hosting and retention preferences are clarified together at the demo stage according to your organization's KVKK policies.

items.title: How long does implementation take?
items.body: It depends on team size, the volume of data to migrate and the stage structure of your sales process. In the demo meeting we listen to your process and draw up a migration plan tailored to you.

items.title: Does it work with other ASH products and our ERP system?
items.body: CRM-X is part of the same product family as HubAI-X, SAPAI-X and Masraf-X, and is designed with the same enterprise approach. Which data is shared with the ERP or SAP side is planned around your needs, drawing on ASH's SAP experience.

sections.heading: Don't Leave Follow-Up to Chance. Own Every Opportunity.
sections.sub: See CRM-X on top of your own sales process. In the meeting we listen to your stages and work out the right setup for your team together.
